headline: Mercor Review: Jobs, Pay & Application Process (2026)
description: Mercor guide covering roles, listed pay, the AI interview, the 2026 security incident and lawsuits, with a source link for every claim.

acceptedAnswer.text: A platform where experts apply to listings from companies that need human input for AI work (source: Mercor Explore page, https://work.mercor.com/explore).
Mercor's Series D post (10 November 2026) lists participants including Benchmark, Felicis, General Catalyst, NVIDIA, Salesforce and Zoom (source: https://www.mercor.com/blog/series-d/).
Mercor says $20 billion after a $750 million Series D announced on 10 November 2026 (source: https://www.mercor.com/blog/series-d/).

mainEntity.name: How long is the Mercor AI interview?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mercor says most take about 20 minutes, though some are shorter or longer (source: https://talent.docs.mercor.com/support/ai-interview.md).
Up to three times across all applications for that interview, per Mercor (source: https://talent.docs.mercor.com/support/ai-interview.md).

mainEntity.name: Does Mercor use my interview data to train AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mercor says it uses it for its internal recommendation models and not for external AI models, and does not sell it (source: https://talent.docs.mercor.com/policies/data-ai-usage.md).
It depends on the role. Check each listing on Mercor's Explore page for current rates. Rates are not a promise (source: https://work.mercor.com/explore).

mainEntity.name: How and when is pay sent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weekly on Wednesdays, through Stripe or Wise by region (source: https://talent.docs.mercor.com/how-to/payments.md).

mainEntity.name: Is Mercor available in my country?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check the Payment Countries page linked from Mercor's How-to page (https://talent.docs.mercor.com/how-to.md) for payments, and the listing for location rules.
